Name: Deconstruct More Things
Author: Suntooth
Description:
[size=3]Stardew Valley doesn't let you deconstruct any item whose crafting recipe makes multiple items, such as bait or certain floors. This lets you deconstruct those items. It also lets you deconstruct fruit tree saplings into the matching fruit (this can be changed using GMCM or config.json).[/size]

[size=3]I may have missed some items, as my list was mostly based on what I can craft in my current main save (Walnut Room level, but not gotten Perfection)[/size][size=3]. If I've missed anything, let me know![/size]

[size=4][b]Balance[/b][/size]
[size=3]In a lot of cases, the Deconstructor might not return an item directly used to craft the craftable[/size][size=3], or might not return the most valuable item. This is an attempt to balance the mod. For example, you craft ten Iron Fences with one iron bar; it wouldn't make sense, then, to turn one Iron Fence into one iron bar, so instead each fence deconstructs into one iron ore. There are also some less intuitive conversions, such as Crystal Paths deconstructing into quartz (not refined quartz, so that [/size][size=3]it's not just directly a refined quartz dupe -[/size][size=3] you also have to sacrifice coal). You may still lose valuable items, such as Deluxe Speed-Gro deconstructing into a Bone Fragment instead of Oak Resin (because otherwise you could easily dupe five Oak Resin). All of that being said though, I don't care if you use this mod to dupe items with the existing outputs.[/size][size=3] Do whatever is fun to you.[/size]

[size=3]A full list of what will be deconstructed into what is below.[/size]
[spoiler][list]
[*]Brick Floor, Quality Retaining Soil: 1x Stone[/*]
[*]Wild Bait: 1x Fiber[/*]
[*]Bait, Magic Bait: 1x Bug Meat[/*]
[*]Deluxe Bait: 1x Bait[/*]
[*]Speed-Gro: 1x Moss[/*]
[*]Fiber Seeds: 1x Sap[/*]
[*]Challenge Bait, Deluxe Speed-Gro: 1x Bone Fragment[/*]
[*]Quality Fertiliser: 2x Sap[/*]
[*]Minecart Tracks, Magnet, Explosive Ammo, Iron Fence: 1x Iron Ore[/*]
[*]Crystal Path, Crystal Floor: 1x Quartz[/*]
[*]Any fruit tree sapling: 1x matching fruit[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]If there's an item in a mod you use that the Deconstructor won't process and you want me to add it to this mod, please post a comment with the following information:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]A link to the mod the item is from.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The name of the item (and the internal ID, if you know how to find it).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The crafting recipe.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][i][b]Optional:[/b][/i] If you have Lookup Anything installed, a screenshot of the menu that appears when pressing F1 (or your usual Lookup Anything key) on the item would be very helpful! (If it's too long for one screenshot, just the very top and very bottom are the most useful parts.)[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]I'll do my best, but it might take a while. If your request doesn't have the above information for [i]every[/i] item you want me to add, I will not be adding the items.[/size]

[size=4][b]Self-promotion[/b][/size]
[size=3]Do you enjoy mods that let you put more things into machines? Try my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12997]Age More Things[/url]! [/size]
